sum_insured_options: ₹4,00,000 (sample schedule; range not specified in wording)

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken; associated medical expenses reduced proportionately

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of SI per day subject to ₹10,000 maximum

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on all admissible claims under in-patient, pre/post-hosp and modern treatments; waivable via optional paid add-on

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 10% of SI, max ₹40,000/eye; modern treatments 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract surgery sub-limit per hospitalisation/surgery; modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.) capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting 48 months for general diseases; 24 months for pre-existing disability; 30 days for HIV/AIDS. Portability credit applicable.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for listed conditions (cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, etc.); 48-month wait for joint replacement, osteoarthritis, ARMD

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge

day_care.note: All day care treatments explicitly covered

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation and day care treatment covered; must be in recognised AYUSH hospital

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure-1 are not payable; no consumables rider available

global_cover.note: Policy restricted to India only; all treatment must be taken in India

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years no look-back except fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for renewal; no coverage during grace period

free_look.note: 15-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy at first inception

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity credit

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, domiciliary hospitalisation, maternity, organ donor hospitalisation, ART cost, sleep disorders, hearing aids, dental (unless accident/disease needing hosp)
